reason: The text is the Song of Moses (Exodus 15), sung by Moses and the children of Israel collectively ('Then Moses and the people of Israel sang this song'). The Israelites are presented as regular people—slaves who have been freed—and the narrative is told from their communal perspective as they celebrate their deliverance. While the song emphasizes God's divine power and intervention, the storytelling voice belongs to the people themselves recounting their own collective experience of salvation and liberation.
